title: Prove chain-nested root optimality: no root mask family has lower D_root than chain(g|g) under the stated hypotheses, 1418.8459 per port at L=18 (no κ)
body:
No κ claim. This adds `research/p104-root-chain-optimality/`, a registered research package for the card `p104-side-correction`.

**Claim.** For a shortest rank-one root with `L = 2g` sites, interval masks, `y` live on the all-field and the host (R2) and singleton hosts (R3), `D_root >= f(8L+1) + 2 sum_{m=1..g} [f(8m+1) - f(8m-8)]` with `f(x) = x ln x`. Equality holds for `chain(g|g)` (the 9|9 root of #6833 at `L = 18`) and its outer-nested twin only; unbalanced chains are strictly worse. At `L = 18` the bound and the chain are both `1418.8458829` per port. Realizability of a family is a sign factorisation `sign(i-j) = p_i q_j` outside the masks; this gives the size staircase `#{fields of size <= t} <= 2t`, and convexity of `f` with increasing `f(8m+1) - f(8m-8)` gives the bound.

**Dropping R2.** An exact Gröbner-basis decision over all families within the chain budget at `L = 4` and `L = 6` finds no gain when every site has a `y` component; dense `y` only loses idle discount.

**Scope.** One loophole is stated, not closed: with one thin query, a site with no `y` component besides the all-field gives realizable families that save 0.43858 at `L = 4, 6` (not computed at `L = 18`, not built or priced). Doubleton hosts are checked exactly only for `L <= 8`. Non-coordinate masks, `D`-dependent bases, non-shortest roots and units of rank above one are outside the statement. No word is constructed and nothing is priced.

**How to verify.** `python3.12 -I -B research/p104-root-chain-optimality/check.py` (standard library only, a few seconds) recomputes the bound, the chain and the twin at every even `L = 4..18`, the unbalanced chains, the staircase over all sign patterns for `L <= 16`, the exhaustive sign-model minima (`697.2194902789` at `L = 18`, equal to the chain), and the six uncovered-pivot savings; it ends with `PASS_P104_ROOT_CHAIN_OPTIMALITY`. `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-root-chain-optimality` reports the package as registered.
